risks: - No material risk and mitigation needed

protected_acceptance_map.title: Exact acceptance identity remains fail-closed
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Generated acceptance IDs must exactly equal the server-derived acceptance IDs in exact order before criterion normalization. Missing, duplicated, invented, malformed or reordered IDs reject the whole generated proposal.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Valid BROWSER proposals remain unchanged
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: A BROWSER criterion that already satisfies the existing strict action, viewport, assertion, screenshot and workflow constructors remains BROWSER with the same bounded proposed fields.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Invalid BROWSER action shape downgrades locally
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: If a criterion explicitly proposed as BROWSER fails an existing protected action-shape rule, only that exact criterion becomes HUMAN_ONLY with empty executable fields; other valid criteria remain unchanged.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Invalid BROWSER workflow structure downgrades locally
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Unregistered viewports, missing assertions, missing screenshots, invalid paths, invalid targets, invalid fixture requirements or other existing protected workflow-constructor failures cause only that BROWSER criterion to become HUMAN_ONLY.

protected_acceptance_map.title: HUMAN_ONLY strips executable fields
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: A criterion explicitly proposed as HUMAN_ONLY normalizes to the exact acceptance ID, mode HUMAN_ONLY, empty viewport_ids and empty actions even if the model supplied executable fields. Those fields never gain authority.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Unknown mode and malformed proposal still fail
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Unknown mode values, non-object criteria, missing acceptance_id fields, unknown criterion keys, malformed top-level structure or unknown top-level keys remain whole-proposal validation failures.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Browser vocabulary exposes exact field contracts
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The fixed server-owned browser vocabulary identifies action-specific required and forbidden fields for NAVIGATE, ASSERT_PATH, semantic target actions, FILL, SELECT and SCREENSHOT, while retaining only registered viewport and semantic-target vocabularies.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Generator guidance prefers HUMAN_ONLY over guessing
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The generation contract explicitly instructs the model to choose HUMAN_ONLY when it cannot confidently express a criterion through the supplied bounded action-field contract, rather than inventing executable details.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Persistence and digest consume normalized output only
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Only the normalized strict `BehavioralPlanProposal` is eligible for compile, canonical digest, persistence, read and explicit approval. Raw model output remains non-durable.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Authenticated production replay proves unchanged authority
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Trusted production replay must successfully draft, read, approve and replay-approve a plan, independently verify exact acceptance text/ID coverage and digest, and prove the frozen Work Specification, Engineering Run and durable Engineering Run event evidence are unchanged.
